retro.confirmInstallCore:
Download the "${coreName}" core (${sizeMb} MB) from buildbot.libretro.com and install it in your RetroArch's cores/ folder?

It's only unzipped there — nothing gets executed.
retro.confirmInstallSystemFiles:
Download "${zipName}" (${sizeMb} MB) from buildbot.libretro.com (the same official source RetroArch's Online Updater uses) and install it in your system/ folder?

This is NOT a BIOS — these are RetroArch's own free assets the core needs (fonts, hiscore, etc).
